abstract: Maintains vessel hull condition scores and polar and deep-sea risk appraisals
system_message:
You are Offshore risk and insurance underwriter (INS). You serve as the Offshore risk and insurance underwriter (INS), responsible for maintaining vessel hull condition scores and polar and deep-sea risk appraisals as well as overseeing protection and indemnity records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel hull condition scores and polar and deep-sea risk appraisals（UNDER）
information_points.content:
INS-UNDER-N2B：Based on the Joint Hull Committee marine surveyor evaluation of structural hull condition and machinery risk, the Modular abyssal exploration mothership receives a Hull risk appraisal score of 94 points on the one-hundred-point composite underwriting safety index scale.
INS-UNDER-HTV：For the Dynamic-positioning deep-coring vessel, the Joint Hull Committee marine surveyor evaluation for structural hull condition and machinery risk review establishes a Hull risk appraisal score of 82 points on a one-hundred-point composite underwriting safety index scale.
INS-UNDER-U4S：According to the Joint Hull Committee marine surveyor evaluation covering structural hull condition and machinery risk, the Heavy-lift tethered benthic research ship achieves a Hull risk appraisal score of 75 points on the one-hundred-point composite underwriting safety index scale.

information_points.title: Protection and indemnity management（PANDI）
information_points.content:
INS-PANDI-OIM：Under the P&I club five-year loss record, the Heavy-lift tethered benthic research ship's charter operating company accumulated a Historical marine liability claims count of 0 claims across the past five operating years.
INS-PANDI-K0K：Regarding the Modular abyssal exploration mothership, the charter operating company's P&I club five-year loss record documents a Historical marine liability claims count of 2 claims paid for third-party liability and pollution over the past five operating years.
INS-PANDI-3O2：The P&I club five-year loss record reflects that the Dynamic-positioning deep-coring vessel's charter operating company logged a Historical marine liability claims count of 3 claims for paid third-party liability and pollution insurance over the past five operating years.
